input: Take a guided architecture walking tour downtown

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific city or downtown area determines which tours, buildings, and operators are available — the entire plan changes by location.
Whether this is solo, with a partner, family, or a group affects tour format, booking logistics, and accessibility needs.
A deadline or target date determines urgency of booking and which scheduled tours are still available.
Architecture tours can focus on specific eras, styles, or building types — knowing the focus shapes which tour or guide is the right fit.
Whether the user wants a pre-organized commercial tour, a self-guided app, or a private guide changes the research and booking steps entirely.
Budget per person affects which tour operators or guide tiers are realistic options, from free walking tours to premium private guides.
The user's primary goal — deep historical knowledge, photography, casual sightseeing, or professional development — determines what makes the tour feel worthwhile.

gold.taskTitle: Take a guided architecture walking tour downtown
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to go on a guided architecture-focused walking tour in a downtown area, either by joining an organized tour or arranging one independently.

questions.title: Which city's downtown are you touring?
questions.description: Identify the specific city or downtown district where the architecture tour will take place, as this determines all available options.

questions.title: Who is joining you on this tour?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a solo trip, a couple, family with children, or a larger group, which affects tour format and booking.

questions.title: Do you have a specific date in mind?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has a target date or timeframe, which drives booking urgency and available tour slots.

questions.title: Which architectural era or style interests you most?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a broad overview or a focused tour on a specific style such as Art Deco, modernist, or 19th-century commercial.

questions.title: Do you prefer a group tour, private guide, or app-led experience?
questions.description: Determine the preferred tour format, as this changes the research, booking steps, and level of personalization involved.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for this tour?
questions.description: Establish a realistic spending range so the right tier of tour operator or guide can be identified.

questions.title: What would make this tour feel like a success?
questions.description: Understand the user's primary motivation — deep historical knowledge, photography, casual fun, or professional insight — to match the right experience.
